Terrible. Differential pricing for foreigners (I'm Uruguayan). According to the employee, it's an order from the gas company. I assume it depends on the employee's appearance or who knows what criteria they use to decide the price. (In Uruguay, Argentinians pay much less for many products and services than Uruguayans themselves.)

reviews.comment:
Buenas. Soy uruguayo. Me encanta recorrer argentina. Ayer el chico de la pista me dijo que el peso subió etc etc , el verso . Ante mi confusión con el tema del cambio accedí. El surtidor marco 2300 $A y me débito de la Targeta 5300$A . Dónde fueron a parar los 3000$A ? Dejan mal o la empresa es parte de ésto? Hoy pensándolo mejor y consultando , si el peso argentino o como sea cambia, el surtidor debería de cambiar . O es un precio para turistas y otro para locales ? Bien , poneme un surtidor que marque lo que pago. Acá o en la china como dice un amigo se paga lo que marca el surtidor . Arriba Axion

(Translated by Google)
Hello. I'm Uruguayan. I love traveling around Argentina. Yesterday, the guy at the gas station told me the peso had gone up, etc., etc., the usual spiel. Confused about the exchange rate, I agreed. The pump showed 2300 ARS and 5300 ARS were debited from my card. Where did the 3000 ARS go? Are they cheating me, or is the company in on this? Thinking about it now, and after checking, if the Argentine peso, or whatever, changes, the pump should change too. Or is there one price for tourists and another for locals? Fine, give me a pump that shows what I'm paying. Here or anywhere, as a friend says, you pay what the pump shows. Go Axion!

Saludamos y esperamos tenga un buen año!

reviews.comment:
(Translated by Google) When I stopped to refuel, the attendant informed me that the price for foreigners was double what was charged at the pump. He recommended an Axion with the normal price. I thanked the attendant for warning me before refueling, but I found this type of attitude at some YPF stations near borders to be an abuse. Like in the case of another YPF in Posadas that refused to refuel my car.
This type of attitude is shameful. In Brazil, this would never happen. A tourist goes to visit Argentina and is treated this way by a gas station chain with a discriminatory policy. It doesn't match the welcoming friendliness of the Argentine people.

(Original)
Quando parei pra abastecer o frentista me avisou que o preço para estrangeiros era o dobro do cobrado na bomba. Me indicou um Axion com preço normal. Agradeci ao frentista por ter me avisado antes de abastecer, mas achei um abuso esse tipo de atitude em alguns postos YPF próximos a fronteiras. Como no caso de outro YPF em Posadas que não quis abastecer meu carro.
Uma vergonha esse tipo de atitude.  No Brasil isso jamais aconteceria. O turista vai conhecer a Argentina e é tratado dessa forma  por uma rede de postos com uma política discriminatória. Não combina com a simpatia acolhedora do povo argentino.
